Media Gallery Section
FRONTEND — Visitor Display
User Story ID
QC-HOME-012 | US001 | REF:
FR-004
Title
Media Gallery Section — Visitor Display
As a
public website visitor
I want
to browse videos and photo albums in the Media Gallery
section on the Home Page
So that
I can view Qatar Chamber media content and navigate to the
full Media Center
Preconditions:
- At least one video or album is published and active in
the Media Center module.
Frontend Workflow:
1. Visitor scrolls to the Media Gallery section on the Home
Page.
2. The section renders with the section tag, heading, and
filter tabs (All Media, Videos, Albums).
3. All Media tab is active by default showing all published
media items.
4. Visitor clicks Videos tab — only published video items
display.
5. Visitor clicks Albums tab — only published photo albums
display.
6. Each video card shows: thumbnail with play button overlay,
Video badge, title, date, and view count.
7. Visitor clicks a video card — the video plays inline or
navigates to the video detail page.
8. Each album card shows: thumbnail, Album badge, title,
date, and photo count.
9. Visitor clicks Explore More CTA — browser redirects to the
full Media Center Home page.
Given the
visitor scrolls to the Media Gallery section
When the
section renders
Then
- The system shall display the section tag, heading,
description and filter tabs (All Media, Videos, Albums).
- The All Media tab shall be active by default showing
all published media items.
- Each video card shall display: thumbnail with play
button overlay, Video badge, title, date, and view count.
- Each album card shall display: thumbnail, Album badge,
title, date, and photo count.
- Clicking a video card shall play the video inline.
- The system shall display an Explore More CTA; clicking
it shall redirect to the full Media Center page.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If a filter tab has no media items the tab shall
display an empty state message.
- If no media item is published the Media Gallery section
shall not render.
Post Condition:
- Visitor can browse, filter, and view media items from
the Home Page and navigate to the full Media Center.
BACKEND — Content Source
User Story ID
QC-HOME-012 | US002 | REF:
FR-004
Title
Media Gallery Section — Content Source
As a
authorized admin user (Site Content Editor)
I want
to manage videos and photo albums from the Media Center
module so they automatically appear in the Media Gallery section on the Home
Page
So that
visitors always see the latest Qatar Chamber media content
on the Home Page
Administrator Workflow:
1. Site Content Editor logs into Liferay CMS.
2. Navigates to Media Center module → Create/Edit Video or
Album.
3. For videos: enters title (bilingual), upload date,
thumbnail, video file or embed URL, and view count (automatically system maintain).
4. For albums: enters album title (bilingual), date, cover
thumbnail, and uploads photos (sourced from Flickr integration).
5. Saves as draft, submits for review, and publishes the
media item.
6. System saves and displays a Liferay generic success toast
message.
7. Published media items automatically appear in the Media
Gallery section on the Home Page.
Given the admin
publishes a video in the Media Center module and Albums through Flicker
When the Home
Page Media Gallery section renders
Then
- The system shall automatically surface the most
recently published videos and albums on the Home Page.
- Media items shall be filterable by type (Videos /
Albums) on the frontend.
- Un-published media items shall not appear in the
section.
- Albumns will be mananged through the Flicker API integration.
Post Condition:
- Published media items appear automatically in the Media
Gallery section on the Home Page.
Note: For Section Tag, Title, Description the requirements is generic thorught the Home page.
